skeletal.title: Skull (Cranium)
skeletal.desc: Protects the brain and supports facial structures.

skeletal.title: Mandible (Jaw)
skeletal.desc: Crucial for chewing and holding prey.

skeletal.title: Cervical Vertebrae
skeletal.desc: The neck bones connecting the skull to the spine.

skeletal.title: Thoracic & Lumbar Spine
skeletal.desc: Provides structural support and houses the spinal cord.

skeletal.title: Rib Cage
skeletal.desc: Protects vital internal organs like the heart and lungs.

skeletal.title: Pelvis
skeletal.desc: Connects the spine to the hind legs.

skeletal.title: Femur
skeletal.desc: The long bone of the hind leg, essential for movement and support.

skeletal.title: Tibia/Fibula
skeletal.desc: The lower hind leg bones.

skeletal.title: Humerus
skeletal.desc: The upper front leg bone.

skeletal.title: Radius/Ulna
skeletal.desc: The lower front leg bones.

muscular.title: Masseter Muscle
muscular.desc: Primary muscle used for chewing and closing the jaw.

muscular.title: Neck Muscles
muscular.desc: Moves the head and neck, extends the front leg.

muscular.title: Latissimus Dorsi
muscular.desc: Retracts the forelimb and flexes the shoulder.

muscular.title: Pectoral Muscles
muscular.desc: Chest muscles used for adduction of the forelimbs.

muscular.title: Gluteal Muscles
muscular.desc: Powerful muscles for running, jumping, and stability.

muscular.title: Hamstring
muscular.desc: Located on the back of the thigh, crucial for propulsion.

muscular.title: Quadriceps
muscular.desc: Front of the thigh, extends the knee joint.

digestive.title: Esophagus
digestive.desc: Transports food from the mouth to the stomach.

digestive.title: Liver
digestive.desc: Filters toxins, produces bile, and aids in digestion.

digestive.title: Small/Large Intestines
digestive.desc: Absorbs nutrients and water from food.

digestive.title: Colon
digestive.desc: Final segment of the digestive tract.

cardiovascular.title: Heart
cardiovascular.desc: Pumps oxygen-rich blood throughout the body.

cardiovascular.title: Aorta
cardiovascular.desc: The main artery carrying blood away from the heart.

cardiovascular.title: Jugular Vein
cardiovascular.desc: Major blood vessel in the neck returning blood to the heart.

cardiovascular.title: Femoral Artery
cardiovascular.desc: Supplies blood to the hind limbs.

nervous.title: Brain
nervous.desc: The central control system for all bodily functions.

nervous.title: Spinal Cord
nervous.desc: The main pathway for information connecting the brain and peripheral nerves.

nervous.title: Sciatic Nerve
nervous.desc: Major nerve serving the hind limbs.

skeletal.title: Skull
skeletal.desc: Features large eye sockets for enhanced night vision.

skeletal.title: Flexible Spine
skeletal.desc: Highly flexible, allowing cats to land on their feet.

skeletal.title: Vestigial Clavicle
skeletal.desc: Floating collarbone that allows squeezing through tight spaces.

skeletal.title: Pelvis
skeletal.desc: Connects the spine to the powerful hind legs.

skeletal.title: Femur
skeletal.desc: Long hind leg bone enabling powerful leaps.

muscular.title: Masseter Muscle
muscular.desc: Strong jaw muscle for gripping and killing prey.

muscular.title: Trapezius
muscular.desc: Stabilizes the shoulder blades during pouncing.

muscular.title: Gluteal Muscles
muscular.desc: Power the explosive jumping ability of cats.

muscular.title: Gastrocnemius
muscular.desc: Calf muscle enabling silent, precise landings.

digestive.title: Esophagus
digestive.desc: Short esophagus suited for an obligate carnivore diet.

digestive.title: Stomach
digestive.desc: Highly acidic stomach for digesting raw meat and bones.

digestive.title: Liver
digestive.desc: Processes proteins and fats from a meat-heavy diet.

digestive.title: Intestines
digestive.desc: Shorter than dogs, reflecting a carnivorous digestive tract.

cardiovascular.title: Heart
cardiovascular.desc: Pumps blood efficiently; prone to hypertrophic cardiomyopathy.

cardiovascular.title: Aorta
cardiovascular.desc: Main artery distributing oxygenated blood from the heart.

cardiovascular.title: Jugular Vein
cardiovascular.desc: Common site for blood draws in feline patients.

nervous.title: Brain
nervous.desc: Highly developed cerebral cortex supporting complex sensory processing.

nervous.title: Spinal Cord
nervous.desc: Transmits signals enabling the cat's agile reflexes.

nervous.title: Optic Nerve
nervous.desc: Large optic nerves support exceptional low-light vision.

skeletal.title: Skull
skeletal.desc: Lightweight skull with a large braincase and fused bones for flight efficiency.

skeletal.title: Beak (Rostrum)
skeletal.desc: Keratinous beak adapted for cracking seeds and foraging.

skeletal.title: Keel (Sternum)
skeletal.desc: Large breastbone providing attachment for powerful flight muscles.

skeletal.title: Furcula (Wishbone)
skeletal.desc: Fused clavicles that act as a spring during the wing stroke.

skeletal.title: Humerus
skeletal.desc: Upper wing bone; hollow to reduce weight for flight.

skeletal.title: Vertebral Column
skeletal.desc: Many vertebrae are fused for rigidity during flight.

skeletal.title: Synsacrum
skeletal.desc: Fused pelvic vertebrae providing a rigid frame for landing.

muscular.title: Pectoralis Major
muscular.desc: The largest muscle; powers the downstroke of the wings.

muscular.title: Supracoracoideus
muscular.desc: Lifts the wing on the upstroke via a pulley-like tendon.

muscular.title: Neck Muscles
muscular.desc: Highly mobile neck muscles compensate for fixed eye sockets.

muscular.title: Leg Muscles
muscular.desc: Positioned close to the body's center of gravity for balance.

digestive.title: Beak / Mouth
digestive.desc: No teeth; food is swallowed whole or in pieces.

digestive.title: Crop
digestive.desc: Expandable pouch that stores and softens food before digestion.

digestive.title: Proventriculus
digestive.desc: Glandular stomach that secretes digestive enzymes.

digestive.title: Gizzard (Ventriculus)
digestive.desc: Muscular stomach that grinds food, replacing the function of teeth.

digestive.title: Intestines
digestive.desc: Relatively short intestines suited to a high-energy diet.

cardiovascular.title: Heart
cardiovascular.desc: Four-chambered heart with a very high resting rate to support flight.

cardiovascular.title: Aorta
cardiovascular.desc: Right aortic arch (unique to birds) distributes oxygenated blood.

cardiovascular.title: Air Sacs
cardiovascular.desc: Nine air sacs create a unidirectional airflow for highly efficient respiration.

nervous.title: Brain
nervous.desc: Enlarged optic lobes and cerebellum support visual acuity and flight coordination.

nervous.title: Optic Nerve
nervous.desc: Large optic nerves connected to eyes that can make up 15% of head mass.

nervous.title: Spinal Cord
nervous.desc: Coordinates wing and leg movements during flight and perching.
